sources.title: BrowseComp: a benchmark for browsing agents - OpenAI
sources.snippet: To measure the ability for AI agents to locate hard-to-find, entangled information on the internet, we are open-sourcing a new benchmark of 1,266 challenging problems called BrowseComp, which stands for "Browsing Competition".
